title: #IUIC | #DEUTERONOMY28PROJECT | Deuteronomy 28:26 | #criticalracetheory #bible #blackhistory
segments: Deuteronomy chapter 28 26 and thy
carcass shall be meat unto all fouls of
the air and unto the beasts of the earth
and no man shall fray them
away. That carcass is talking about our
people, the Israelites, the dead bodies.
This is a quote from the history of
slavery by Susan Efford. The tree of
death, it was bounded by great rocks
wherein the hyenas had their dens and
could eat the bodies of the people
executed. Its upper branches were
covered with innumerable vultures. This
is what the Arabs did to us. Take a look
at the picture. This is where they hung
the bodies of
slaves. and thy carcass shall be meat
unto all fowls of the air and unto the
beasts of the earth. Here is another
article. This is from the New York Times
1994 about our ancestors. Estimates of
how many blacks were lost at sea in the
roughly 400 years of the slave trade in
the Americas vary widely. Some like Mr.
Ike placed a figure between 100 million
and 200 million. Others say perhaps as
many as 14 million people perish.
Whichever is true, many historians note
that the numbers of enslaved Africans
who died at sea were so great that
sharks learned to follow the slave
routes because they fed on the body
strong over. Deuteronomy 28:26. No man
will be able to fray away these beasts.
Shalom.
